description: Defines a template class QuicheLinkedHashMap implementing a simplistic insertion-ordered map using a list and a hash map for internal storage, with methods for insertion, deletion, iteration, and lookup.

classes.name: QuicheLinkedHashMap
classes.description: A template class implementing an insertion-ordered map with basic map functionalities, using a list for order and a hash map for fast lookup.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to the first element in insertion order.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator past the last element.

methods.name: rbegin
methods.description: Returns reverse iterator to the last inserted element.

methods.name: rend
methods.description: Returns reverse iterator past the first element.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all elements from the map.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the map is empty.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes element(s) by key or iterator.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses or inserts element by key.
